# AI assistants that can make phone calls for you (2026)

As of 2026, only a few AI assistants can place and receive real phone calls. Arlo makes and takes live calls for work — confirming appointments, chasing vendors, fielding inbound questions — then summarizes each call and updates your records, with approvals and an audit trail. Mitra, Martin, and Catch offer calling for personal use; ChatGPT and Slack-only AI employees cannot touch a phone line.

By the Arlo teamUpdated August 8, 2026 · 6 min read [...] ## Why most AI assistants can't call

Real calling is hard in an unglamorous way: telephony infrastructure, live speech in both directions, barge-in and hold music, voicemail detection, and — hardest — acting responsibly as your representative to a stranger. A misdialed judgment call embarrasses you, so calling only works wrapped in the same governance as any consequential action. That's why chat products haven't bolted it on: it isn't a feature, it's a surface. As of July 2026, ChatGPT doesn't place calls for you, and Slack-native AI employees like Viktor don't touch the phone at all.

results.content:
# Google’s Gemini Can Now Make Calls for You on Pixel Phones

Google has been trying to have its AI assistant make phone calls on your behalf for almost 10 years. Remember Duplex? It enabled the now-defunct Google Assistant to call restaurants and book tables. That service was shuttered a few years ago, but now comes round two, powered by modern large language models.

On Thursday, Google announced Call for Me, an experimental beta feature exclusive to its latest Pixel 11 smartphones in the US (and in English). Pixel 11 owners need a Gemini subscription and have to be enrolled in the Phone by Google app’s public beta. Google has instructions on how to participate here.
